files.name: coordinate-projections.csv

files.name: geodesic-direct-ellipsoids.csv
files.source: GeodSolve -f -p 9 -e a f (sphere, f = 1/150, f = 1/50, f = -1/150, f = -1/50)

files.name: geodesic-ellipsoids.csv
files.source: GeodSolve -i -f -p 9 -e a f (sphere, f = 1/150, f = 1/50, f = -1/150, f = -1/50)

files.name: geodesic-wgs84.csv
files.source: GeodSolve -i -f -p 9 (azi1, azi2, s12, a12, m12, M12, M21, S12)
